part.name: OD-G10_porta_filter_holder
part.what_it_is: Espresso-machine portafilter holder (group-head collar), moulded plastic: a cup with three internal bayonet lugs (stop block, ramped underside, top channel), a stepped shelf with under-lug pockets, a lip ring and a bottom plate with a two-lobed water opening and two screw bosses.

method_summary: Intake: scan hashed, working copy, noise floor on the lug top pads, coverage map (C1-C6), feature list from mesh and both photos, band regime declared by the owner (baseline-skill plastic), scan-only.
Datum: lug top pads -> XY at z = 0; outer cup wall axis -> Z; 3-fold lug phase -> clock; tilt measured.

Measure: r-z and theta-z maps on the full-res scan, per-lug angular extents, line and cylinder fits (bore draft, lug underside edge, concave under-lug floors), photo-inferred plate interior; every value with source and rule in measure/params.json.
Rebuild: one revolved profile + revolved sectors per gap and per lug + three lug instances at 120 deg pitch + cut tools; build123d, one closed solid, all-analytic faces, datum- and scan-frame STEP.
Verify in a fresh agent: returned HALT because its own ICP did not converge (gate INVALID). The owner chose to take delivery as is; the verdict stays HALT.

limitations.text: NO OFFICIAL GRADE. Verdict HALT: the independent ICP did not converge, so the full-res Tier-2 gate is INVALID. The numbers in this README are inspection-only: datum-frame scan to CAD p95 {{gate:deviation_datum_frame.scan_to_cad.p95}} / max {{gate:deviation_datum_frame.scan_to_cad.max}} mm against the p95 {{gate:regime.bands.p95_mm}} / max {{gate:regime.bands.max_mm}} band. Delivered on the owner's explicit override, not because a gate passed.
limitations.rerun_trigger: tier2_icp.py fixed to exclude the declared CAD-side coverage regions and antiparallel-normal pairs -> re-run verify in a fresh agent

limitations.text: Tier-1 not run (no calipers): tier1 partial, none of the requested dims measured; absent is not passed.
limitations.rerun_trigger: filled input/MEASUREMENTS.md with caliper readings -> re-run verify

limitations.text: Absolute scale not caliper-verified (CHK-SCALE not run; units assumed mm).
limitations.rerun_trigger: one caliper reading of ENV-D (outer cup diameter) and ENV-Z2 -> re-run verify

limitations.text: Independent ICP did not converge (see verify's diagnosis): unscanned CAD faces pair with the opposite wall with antiparallel normals and pull the registration; the post-ICP numbers are biased and the datum-frame vs post-ICP scan_to_cad p95 differ by more than the band (datum finding reported by verify).
limitations.rerun_trigger: human decision on the registration protocol, e.g. an ICP that excludes the declared coverage regions -> re-run verify
limitations.evidence: qa/gate.json#auto_limitations: datum-frame vs post-ICP scan_to_cad p95 differ by 0.728 mm (> band 0.3 mm); qa/icp_diagnose.json

limitations.text: Coverage: the scan has no underside, no outer wall over theta 38-151 deg, nothing below the scan extent and no plate interior; the CAD surfaces there are not evidence-backed and the observable CAD to scan number is dominated by coverage, not geometry.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a scan with the C6 sector, the underside and the under-lug region covered -> re-run verify

limitations.text: Photo-inferred and assumed geometry is not graded: plate keyhole, bosses and side hole (photo-only), plate thickness, lower wall, lug undersides and stop radial depth (hidden).
limitations.rerun_trigger: caliper readings F-KEY, F-BOSS, F-PLATE, F-LUGT, F-STOP or a photo with a scale -> re-run verify

limitations.text: Datum audit (report-only): axis and origin agree with the builder; the 3-fold Fourier clock differs by {{gate:datum_audit.angle_deg}} deg overall and is region-sensitive on this part.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a clock datum on a named flat face (e.g. a lug stop face) agreed with the owner -> re-run datum audit

limitations.text: Full resolution is an agent declaration, not an owner statement.
limitations.rerun_trigger: owner says the upload was decimated -> re-run verify on the original

limitations.text: Unenumerated feature: photo 1 shows a small rectangular window at the base of the outer cup wall (flange junction), below the scanned region; it is not modelled.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a scan or caliper reading of the lower wall -> add the feature and re-run

limitations.text: Builder iterations inside it1 were steered by a builder self-check against the same scan (consistency check, not independent evidence); the independent datum-frame number is the one quoted above.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a converged independent ICP gate -> quote only the official numbers

assumptions.text: The inner stepped ring (shelf, pockets, lip) is modelled as part of the one solid; it may be a separate rubber gasket.
Outer wall continues as the same cylinder over the unscanned sector; the solid is closed by a flat face at the scan extent (not a real face).

not_fit_for: Anything that needs an official deviation grade: the gate is INVALID (HALT).

Manufacture, tooling or fit-critical use (bayonet engagement): scale and all dimensions are uncalipered; lug undersides, stop depth, plate underside and everything below the plate are assumed; the plate keyhole, bosses and holes are photo-inferred.
Evidence of the outer wall over theta 38-151 deg or below the scan extent (unscanned).
fit_for: A design-intent parametric starting model (build/model.py + measure/params.json) to be refined with calipers and a fuller scan.
Visual and packaging studies of the scanned upper cup region.

feature_tree.feature: revolved cup profile (outer wall, stepped rim, drafted bore, plate, lower wall)
3 gap sectors: shelf per gap + lip with fitted edge rounding
3 lug sectors cut by fitted concave cylinders (pocket floors)
3 bayonet lugs: stop block, two underside planes, channel
bore recess + groove behind each lug
